//: The Run an app tab of the window, field by field and option by option, with the command line option that does the same. Part of the documentation (site/data/docs.json), so English and Polish only. The pictures in site/assets/docs/ are real, see first-session/page.json. The window is in English, so the Polish page names its fields in English too.

en.title: The Run an app tab of Chrono Mock - every field and option
en.description: Every field and option of the tab that starts an application on another date: the date and time zone, the speed, the options for web pages inside an application, the session screen and the result.

pl.title: Karta Run an app w Chrono Mock - każde pole i opcja
pl.description: Każde pole i opcja karty, która uruchamia aplikację w innej dacie: data i strefa, tempo, opcje dla stron w aplikacji, ekran sesji i wynik.
